scope: First SECURITY_BOUND diagnostic from inspectSecurityPolicy over a schema-valid policy whose condition is an admitted 0.1.0 expression. Schema errors, term semantics, ontology closure, raw-host accessors and whole-policy interpretation are outside this packet.
oracleMethod: The predecessor increments one shared node counter on each depth-first visit, uses one-based root depth, and appends SECURITY_BOUND at the first depth>16 or node>4096 visit. This packet records the first such diagnostic; the TypeScript inspector may continue sibling traversal and append later bound diagnostics.
limitations: The Rust helper is an internal core primitive over already schema-admitted tagged ASTs; it is not a schema validator or policy inspector.
The helper stops at the first bound violation and applies invocation work controls. It does not implement the TypeScript inspector's full ordered diagnostic list.
No `requireSecurityInterpretation`, authorization, policy evaluation, default route or raw-host parity claim is made.
